title: Apprenticeship Coach
description:
Responsibilities:

• Responsible for assessing projects, assignments and support individuals working towards an apprenticeship qualification. Deliver remote learner sessions and 1:1 review to support working towards and preparing for End Point Assessment. Ensure learners achieve and that a high quality of evidence is obtained.

• To do this successfully and so we can track progress of learners, we have invested in MyLearning which is the platform you will work from to track learner contact, progress, action planning and feedback.

• You will deliver 1:1 coaching sessions once per month (some delivery models may differ) with learners to support their progression against the knowledge, skills and behaviours within their programme. You will set targets with your learners, create action plans and where possible stretch and challenge them to exceed expectations.

• Responsibility for the success of the learner at EPA is no mean feat, which is why a holistic approach to development is critical. You should know your learners, their context, their role, business and line manager inside and out. Natural curiosity is essential to know how you can support them in the best way possible.

• This is not a standalone role, ultimately the success of a learner is your responsibility but it takes the whole OPG family to set you and your learner up for success. Lean on your team and support each other to provide a brilliant experience to our learners.

• You will be your learners go to person from the moment they onboard on to a programme to successful achievement. It is your responsibility to familiarise yourself with every step of their learning journey.

What you can expect from us
• Flexibility, we champion flexible working and have invested in processes and systems to make your work easy to engage with.
• Learners who are committed to their learning journey and will challenge you to go the extra mile. Learners of any age and background from 19 - 65 years old.
• Working with learner populations of 40- 50 people for a period of 12 - 18 months.
• Remote working from anywhere, we have the technology in place for you to support, coach and engage with your learners in a high touch way, virtually.
• Working with Enterprise level clients and SMEs across all sectors from financial services, manufacturing, technology and creative.
About you

• You will have one or more coaching specialism which will benefit multiple cohorts of learners. It is also essential that you obtain a TAQA or relevant qualifications.

• You will love helping people become the best version of themselves while getting satisfaction from seeing people grow and build confidence.

• You will be decisive, good at planning and organising, solving problems, adaptable and focused on achieving goals

*This is a fully remote role, you can be based anywhere in the UK*
The Opportunity Group is growing. The world of Apprenticeship learning continues to solve an ever growing gap in workforce capability and provides the essential funding support many business needs if they’re ever going to focus on new and existing employee development.
This is your chance to be part of something truly unique. What we do isn’t rocket science but how we do it is brilliant. We are on a mission to cut through the complexities of the apprenticeship reforms and funding to help organisations and their people access life- long learning opportunities.

title: Registered Nurse (RN) – Home Health (PRN)
description:
Position Summary Nurturing Home Healthcare is seeking a compassionate and experienced Registered Nurse (RN) - Home Health (PRN) to provide high-quality, patient-centered care to individuals in their homes in Houston, TX. The RN will perform skilled nursing visits, complete patient assessments, develop and implement care plans, and collaborate with physicians, caregivers, and interdisciplinary team members to ensure optimal patient outcomes.
The ideal candidate is clinically skilled, self-motivated, and committed to delivering exceptional home healthcare services while maintaining compliance with Medicare regulations, agency standards, and professional nursing practices.
Key Responsibilities Conduct comprehensive patient assessments in the home setting. Develop, implement, and update individualized care plans based on patient needs. Provide skilled nursing services, including wound care, medication management, disease management, and patient education. Evaluate patient progress and communicate changes in condition to physicians and appropriate healthcare providers. Complete start-of-care, recertification, resumption-of-care, transfer, and discharge assessments. Accurately complete OASIS documentation as required. Educate patients and caregivers regarding medications, treatments, disease processes, and safety measures. Coordinate care with physicians, therapists, social workers, and other members of the healthcare team. Ensure compliance with agency policies, Medicare guidelines, and professional nursing standards. Maintain timely and accurate clinical documentation within the electronic medical record system. Participate in interdisciplinary case conferences and care coordination meetings. Support quality improvement initiatives and patient satisfaction goals. Respond appropriately to patient needs and changes in health status. Promote patient independence, safety, and overall well-being. Required Qualifications Current and unrestricted Registered Nurse (RN) license in the State of Texas. Minimum of one (1) year of nursing experience required. Previous Home Health experience preferred. OASIS experience or willingness to complete training. Knowledge of Medicare regulations and home health standards. Strong clinical assessment and critical-thinking skills. Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities. Ability to work independently and manage multiple patient visits efficiently. Reliable transportation and valid driver's license. Current CPR certification or ability to obtain upon hire. Proficiency with electronic medical record systems and documentation. Preferred Qualifications Two or more years of Home Health nursing experience. Experience with WellSky (Kinnser) or similar Home Health EMR systems. Strong knowledge of Medicare Conditions of Participation (CoPs). Experience managing chronic disease populations. Wound care certification or advanced clinical training. Bilingual abilities (English/Spanish) preferred. Experience working with geriatric and medically complex patients. BSN preferred but not required. Physical Requirements Ability to travel frequently between patient homes within the assigned service area. Ability to stand, walk, bend, kneel, and reach during patient visits. Ability to lift, transfer, or assist patients as needed, up to 50 pounds with appropriate support. Ability to use nursing equipment and perform clinical procedures safely. Ability to sit for extended periods while completing documentation. Visual acuity sufficient to assess patients and review medical records. Manual dexterity required for documentation, medication administration, and nursing procedures. Ability to communicate effectively with patients, caregivers, and healthcare professionals. Ability to work in varying home environments and conditions.

title: Cyber Threat Hunter
description:
College Board - Technology - Information Security Office
Location: This is a fully remote role. Candidates who live near CB offices have the option of being fully remote or hybrid (Tuesday and Wednesday in office).
Type: This is a full-time position

About the Team 
The Cyber Security Operations team is critical to the strategic foundation of our products, most notably the secure delivery of our Digital SAT and AP programs. We are a highly motivated group of cyber security professionals who take a proactive approach to ensuring a strong security posture. We partner across the organization to mature our Threat Management and Incident Response procedures and are constantly seeking and experimenting with new technologies. We are currently using a variety of cutting-edge tools that provide comprehensive cyber security operations for the College Board ’s critical infrastructure in support of the College Board ’s mission to connect students to college success and opportunity.

We learn by doing. The team experiments with different ideas, works out solutions together, and encourages each person to pursue what they are passionate about, whether that is building a new capability, automating threat hunts, or creating new internal tools. A strong managed detection and response partnership and a deliberately balanced on-call model keep alert fatigue low, so the team can focus on meaningful threat hunting and the investigations that matter.

About the Opportunity  
As a Cyber Threat Hunter, you will play a hands-on role in defending the cloud and enterprise environments that power the Digital SAT, AP, and other high-stakes programs. You will work in an AWS-heavy environment at national scale, where proactive, hypothesis-driven threat hunting, careful investigation, and clear documentation directly support exam integrity and student trust.

This is an early-career role for someone with strong cyber defense foundations who is eager to learn fast. You will start by getting to know our environment and tools, then move into threat hunts paired with senior engineers, help build and tune detections, support incident investigations, and bring a fresh perspective to our playbooks. Over time, you will help validate controls through purple team exercises and use automation to make our workflows faster and more reliable.

You will partner closely with engineers, architects, product security, GRC, and product teams to close visibility gaps and reduce risk in practical, measurable ways. Success in this role means fewer blind spots, higher fidelity alerts, and a cyber defense program that is proactive rather than reactive.

In this role, you will:
Threat Hunting & Detection Engineering (45%)

• Execute hypothesis-driven threat hunts across AWS, identity, endpoint, and network telemetry, starting alongside senior engineers, and document findings and recommended control or detection improvements.

• Help build, tune, and maintain detections focused on high-risk behaviors such as IAM misuse, persistence, privilege escalation, and data access or exfiltration.

• Reduce alert noise through structured tuning, baselining, and enrichment while preserving meaningful coverage.

• Map detections and hunts to MITRE ATT&CK techniques to identify and close visibility gaps.

Incident Response & Investigation (30%)

• Support investigation and containment of security incidents by performing log analysis, helping scope impact, and documenting findings.

• Contribute to the development and refinement of incident response playbooks for common cloud and identity-based scenarios.

• Contribute clear after-action reports that identify root cause, control gaps, and prioritized remediation steps.

• Participate in periodic tabletop or fire drill exercises to validate readiness and improve response coordination.

Purple Teaming & Continuous Improvement (15%)

• Participate in purple team exercises to validate detection effectiveness and help prioritize remediation of identified

title: Remote Medical Director - New York and North Carolina
description:
About the Role

Willow Health delivers virtual-first crisis stabilization and bridge care where appropriate to people who wouldotherwise land in an emergency department or an inpatient bed. We serve currently patients over 18 with behavioral health conditions.

The Medical Director is Willow's senior practicing psychiatrist and the physician accountable for the quality and safety of care delivered every day. This is a working clinical leadership role: you will carry your own panel, serve as the supervising or collaborating physician for our nurse practitioners, and own the day-to-day clinical operations of the programs - escalations, coverage, case review, and the judgment calls that determine whether a patient stabilizes at home or needs a higher level of care.

You will report to the Chief Medical Officer and partner closely with our clinical supervisors, clinical operations,compliance, and product. This role is designed for a psychiatrist who wants to collaborate in building andimproving a care model rather than inherit one.

• Reports to : Chief Medical Officer

• Direct reports: Nurse practitioners; physician colleagues as the medical staff grows

• Location: Remote (New York and North Carolina markets)

• Status: Full-time, exempt

• Time allocation: Approximately 50% direct patient care, 50% clinical leadership and oversight

• Working hours for the clinic are Monday - Friday from 10:30 AM to 7:30 PM Eastern Time.

Key Responsibilities

Direct patient care

• Carry a clinical panel across crisis stabilization and bridge services, including initial psychiatric evaluations, medication management, and crisis psychotherapy encounters.

• Serve as the physician of record for high-acuity and diagnostically complex patients, including those with co-occurring substance use disorders.

• Provide same-day and urgent assessments when risk escalates, and make the level-of-care determination when a patient needs transfer to a higher level of care.

• Document to clinical and billing standard, including structured risk assessment and the elements required for crisis psychotherapy coding.
Supervision of nurse practitioners

• Serve as supervising or collaborating physician for Willow's psychiatric nurse practitioners in accordance with New York and North Carolina requirements, including written collaborative or supervisory agreements, required chart review, and documented quality improvement meetings.

• Provide real-time clinical backup: be reachable for consultation on risk, medication, and disposition questions during clinical hours.

• Run recurring individual/group supervision and group case conference; set expectations for prescribing practice, risk assessment, and documentation.

• Complete competency assessment, onboarding sign-off, and performance input for each NP in partnership with the CMO.
Daily clinical operations

• Own day-to-day clinical operations of Willow’s programs: daily huddle, escalation pathway, after-hours protocol, and the clinical standards that govern on-call and coverage.

• Triage and resolve clinical escalations from the care team; serve as the final clinical decision-maker on urgent matters within the scope set by the CMO.

Crash Course, owned by Complexly , is an award-winning YouTube channel that invites students, teachers, and lifelong learners to tackle subjects they might have had trouble with or are curious to learn more about. Cosuno is a platform for construction tendering in the German-speaking market. It connects general contractors, who publish bid packages, with subcontractors, who bid on them, and both sides pay. HOW WE WORK

description:
Senior Software Engineer
Would you enjoy working with large distributed systems ?
Do you enjoy using your expertise to mentor others ?
Join our cutting-edge Web Security Team
Our team develops and sells Akamai's carrier network security products to fixed and mobile network service providers. We specialize in delivering highly scalable network infrastructure and access-based security products to our customers. We collaborate with product groups, external partners to enable our customers to provide high-quality, secure internet and network access to their end-users.
Develop secure, reliable and maintainable code
As Software Engineer.Senior , you'll develop software that runs one of the largest distributed-systems in the world. You will play a key role in our growth strategy. You'll be creating innovative solutions for our network challenges and clients, with the aim of increasing internet traffic and making it faster, more reliable and secure.
As a Software Engineer Senior , you will be responsible for:

• Collaborating with other software engineering teams to influence and shape the design process and product development

• Creating and enhancing new features and functionality, including conception, design, testing and deployment

• Being the subject matter and team expert, leading and mentoring others to optimize their productivity

• Working with internal teams to troubleshoot complex problems in our network for our customers

Do what you love
To be successful in this role you will:

• Have 3+ years in experience in software development life cycles and writing code in Golang/C/C++ within a Unix/Linux environment

• Have understanding of how internet and it's networks/protocols (IP, DNS, routing, HTTP, TCP or web architecture) works

• Demonstrate a keen interest in learning new technologies

• Be a natural communicator with an interest in mentoring others using your subject matter expertise

• Have experience in cloud platforms such as AWS/GCP/Azure etc

• Be adept on Cloud native constructs and deployments

•
Build your career at Akamai

Our ability to shape digital life today relies on developing exceptional people like you. The kind that can turn impossible into possible. We’re doing everything we can to make Akamai a great place to work. A place where you can learn, grow and have a meaningful impact.

With our company moving so fast, it’s important that you’re able to build new skills, explore new roles, and try out different opportunities. There are so many different ways to build your career at Akamai, and we want to support you as much as possible. We have all kinds of development opportunities available, from programs such as GROW and Mentoring, to internal events like the APEX Expo and tools such as Linkedin Learning, all to help you expand your knowledge and experience here.

Not sure if this job is the right match for you or want to learn more about the job before you apply? Schedule a 15-minute exploratory call with the Recruiter and they would be happy to share more details.

title: Principal Engineer - Civil Structural
description:
Position Overview
Power your future with Qualus in our Engineering department as a Principal Civil Structural Engineer. In this role, the candidate will design and detail mat and pier type foundations for substation structures. Additionally, the candidate will design substation structures ranging from simple equipment supports to overhead line towers. All work will be performed with emphasis on quality and project costs following client’s requirements and internal company’s quality control and quality assurance practices.
The candidate may also complete substation designs, as necessary. Work will include applying applicable codes and client standards to design general arrangements, equipment and electrical layouts, elevation views, grading and fence plans, foundation plan and details, substation rigid bus arrangements, structure details, and bills of material.
This position may be based in Lake Mary, FL; Palm Beach Gardens, FL; Las Vegas, NV, Boise, ID; Raleigh, NC; or Fort Worth, TX offices or remotely in the US or Canada.
Responsibilities

• Develop overall conceptual design plans in the initial development phase of new projects.

• Work with renewable energy developers and other clients with support specific to schedules and cost estimates.

• Design foundations using commercially available software such as LPILE.

• Develop steel structure models for rigid bus and equipment supports.

• Perform company’s Quality Assurance/Quality Control (QA/QC) processes.

• Establish and maintain professional relationships with our external business partners; Present information and respond to questions from individual or groups of clients.

• Direct and/or participate in client meetings/job site visits to collect or deliver design and engineering data.

• Mentor less experienced staff on a wide range of technical and project management skills.

• Coordinate with other engineering disciplines.

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelors of Science or Masters in Civil Engineering from an ABET accredited institution.

• 15+ years of experience performing civil structural engineering calculations.

• Proficient with drafting programs such as AutoCAD and MicroStation a plus.

• Active Professional Engineering (PE) license

• Experience in transmission, distribution and generating stations is a plus.

• Must have strong analytical and computer skills. Must be able to identify necessary software to complete needed design work.

• Experience leading and mentoring a team

title: VP, Client Strategy & Performance
description:
At R1, we’re transforming how healthcare works by combining nearly two decades of revenue cycle expertise with advanced technology, including analytics, AI, intelligent automation and workflow orchestration. We pair that technology with the irreplaceable expertise of our people to help hospitals, health systems and medical groups improve financial performance, simplify administrative complexity and create better experiences for patients and providers.
All Together Better defines our culture and the way we work. We’re a diverse, global team united by a shared mission to make healthcare work better for all. Across technology, operations and support functions, our people bring deep expertise, empathy and ingenuity to the work we do. Here, collaboration fuels progress, adaptability sparks innovation and every voice can help shape what’s next for R1 and the future of healthcare.

We are seeking an accomplished Vice President, Strategic Customer Partnerships to lead complex enterprise customer relationships and drive measurable performance, operational improvement, and transformation.

This executive will serve as a trusted advisor to senior customer leaders while partnering across operational and service delivery teams. The ideal candidate combines deep Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) knowledge, executive presence, analytical depth, strategic storytelling, and operational leadership, with the ability to translate complex data into clear insights, recommendations, and action.

Essential Responsibilities

• Lead and develop Customer Partner leaders responsible for strategic customer relationships and performance.

• Serve as a trusted advisor to senior executives, providing clear visibility into RCM performance, opportunities, priorities, and strategic initiatives.

• Translate complex operational and performance analytics into compelling executive-level narratives and actionable recommendations.

• Partner across service delivery, operations, and functional teams to align priorities and drive measurable improvement.

• Leverage RCM expertise and industry best practices to guide customer strategy, optimize performance, and advance transformation.

• Lead change through influence, building alignment across complex, matrixed stakeholder groups.

• Advance customer experience and relationship health, including efforts supporting KLAS and NPS performance.

• Develop and strengthen the Customer Partner organization through coaching, accountability, and talent development.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant professional experience.

• 12+ years of progressive experience, including at least 8 years in leadership or management.

• Deep knowledge of healthcare Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) and demonstrated experience driving performance improvement in complex healthcare environments.

• Demonstrated success managing complex, executive-level customer or client relationships.

• Strong analytical capabilities with experience translating RCM and operational data into strategic business recommendations.

• Exceptional executive communication, presentation, and storytelling skills.

• Experience leading cross-functional performance improvement, transformation, or change initiatives.

• Proven ability to lead and influence across a matrixed organization.

The successful candidate will be equally comfortable understanding revenue cycle performance, interpreting complex analytics, identifying the story behind the numbers, and translating those insights into an executive strategy that drives action.

For this US-based position, the base pay range is $211,268.66 - $264,085.82 per year . title: Inbound Sales Representative
description:
Salonkee is een van de snelstgroeiende beautytech-bedrijven van Europa en helpt duizenden salons hun dagelijkse werking te vereenvoudigen en hun klanten een uitzonderlijke ervaring te bieden.

Onze alles-in-één software maakt het plannen van afspraken, betalingen en klantenbeheer eenvoudig, zodat salons zich kunnen concentreren op wat echt telt: het leveren van een uitstekende klantervaring.

We zijn er trots op de toekomst van de beauty-industrie vorm te geven met innovatie, samenwerking en een mensgerichte aanpak.

DE KANS

Als Inbound Sales Representative voor Vlaanderen ben jij het eerste aanspreekpunt voor salons die interesse hebben in Salonkee. Je reageert snel op binnenkomende leads, geeft online productdemo's, sluit nieuwe klanten af en zorgt ervoor dat ze vlot van start gaan dankzij onboarding en opleiding op afstand. De functie is volledig remote: al het klantcontact verloopt via videocall, telefoon en e-mail. Je speelt een centrale rol in de groei van ons klantenbestand in Vlaanderen en helpt Salonkee uit te bouwen tot dé softwareoplossing voor salons.

WAT GA JE DOEN:

- Snelle opvolging van binnenkomende leads: Je reageert snel op demo-aanvragen, registraties via de website en marketingleads, kwalificeert ze telefonisch of via videocall en plant de juiste volgende stap in.

- Advies over digitalisering in de wellness- en beautysector: Je brengt in kaart waar elke salonuitbater mee worstelt - van no-shows en personeelsplanning tot de kassa - en adviseert hoe Salonkee hun zaak kan verbeteren.

- Online productdemo's: Je geeft boeiende productdemo's via videocall, afgestemd op de noden van elke salon.

- Nieuwe klanten binnenhalen: Je beantwoordt vragen, gaat in op bezwaren, volgt op via e-mail en telefoon en sluit contracten af - volledig op afstand.

- Onboarding en opleiding op afstand: Zodra een salon tekent, begeleid je hen bij de opstart en geef je de uitbater en het team online opleidingen, zodat ze vanaf dag één het maximum uit Salonkee halen.

- Pipeline- en CRM-beheer: Je houdt je pipeline en het CRM up-to-date en werkt naar duidelijke doelstellingen, zoals reactietijd op leads, aantal demo's en conversie naar klanten.

- Zelfstandige planning van je werkweek: Je organiseert je eigen tijd en werkt gestructureerd van thuis uit om de beste resultaten te behalen.

WAT WE IN JOU ZOEKEN:

- Nederlands als moedertaal of vloeiend; een goede kennis van het Frans is een sterke troef; een werkkennis van het Engels

- 1 à 3 jaar ervaring in sales of een andere klantgerichte functie - of een sterke leergierigheid

- Je komt zelfzeker en boeiend over op camera en kan de aandacht van een salonuitbater vasthouden tijdens een online demo van 30 à 45 minuten

- Een consultatieve aanpak: je stelt de juiste vragen en luistert voor je pitcht

- Je kan software eenvoudig en geduldig uitleggen, zodat je salonteams online kan opleiden

- Sterke schriftelijke communicatie voor heldere opvolgmails en berichten

- Zelfdiscipline, een positieve mindset en een gestructureerde manier van remote werken

- Een rustige werkplek thuis en een stabiele internetverbinding

- Pluspunt: ervaring met SaaS-sales of kennis van de wellness- en beautysector

 

WAT WIJ BIEDEN:

title: Manufacturing Engineer
description:
ABOUT US:

Quartermaster is building the world's most comprehensive maritime intelligence platform. Our SmartMast™ system transforms commercial and civilian vessels into a persistent, distributed sensing network-combining HD video, AI, radar, RF sensing, and AIS to deliver real-time maritime domain awareness at global scale. With 600+ sensors deployed across 25+ countries and more than 400,000 vessels identified outside of AIS, we are setting a new standard for what ocean surveillance and safety can look like. We are a mission-driven, high-velocity team building dual-use technology for defense agencies, coast guards, and commercial maritime operators.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

We are seeking a Manufacturing Engineer to support our team’s growing production demands and process improvement goals across Quartermaster’s SmartMast™ systems and related marine products. Based out of our Arlington, VA office, this role will play a critical part in onboarding and transitioning production to additional contract manufacturers (CMs), reducing assembly downtime, improving first-pass yield, and freeing up our core R&D engineers to focus on next-generation design and product improvements.

The right candidate brings strong hands-on experience scaling electromechanical hardware production with external contract manufacturers, translating engineering designs into repeatable manufacturing processes, and driving continuous improvements on the production floor.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Lead manufacturing transfer, line setup, and onboarding activities as Quartermaster expands production across new and existing contract manufacturers (CMs).

- Develop, optimize, and maintain manufacturing work instructions, assembly procedures, test fixtures, and tooling to reduce build times and prevent assembly errors.

- Drive continuous process improvements across production lines to reduce downtime, eliminate bottlenecks, and increase first-pass yield and throughput.

- Partner closely with Mechanical, Electrical, and Quality Engineering teams on Design for Manufacturability and Assembly (DFMA), Engineering Change Orders (ECOs), and New Product Introduction (NPI) builds.

- Troubleshoot production-line equipment, test station, and assembly issues in real time, implementing durable corrective actions so design engineers can stay focused on future product development.

- Track production metrics (cycle time, yield, scrap/rework rates, line capacity) and collaborate with Supply Chain and CMs to support scaling production volumes.

QUALIFICATIONS (PREFERRED):

- Bachelor’s degree in Manufacturing, Mechanical, Industrial, or Electrical Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

- 3-5+ years of experience in manufacturing engineering for electromechanical hardware, marine electronics, aerospace/defense, or ruggedized outdoor systems.

- Proven experience working directly with contract manufacturers (CMs) to transfer, qualify, and scale hardware production lines.

- Strong command of DFMA principles, assembly tooling/fixture design, process validation (PFMEA, Control Plans), and lean manufacturing methodologies.

title: Sales Operations Lead

You'll partner closely with EMEA sales leadership to drive the day-to-day operating rhythm of the team - forecasting, pipeline reviews, and planning - and dig into the data to identify risks and opportunities for growth.

This is a role for an operator who builds what they design and has already rewired their work around AI. Alongside the operating rhythm, your project work will be building AI agents, tools, and workflows that help our AEs, SDRs, and Solutions teams move our revenue metrics.

This position is based in our London office 4 days per week.

You will:

- Partner closely with EMEA sales leaders to shape and execute our growth strategy in the region

- Strong analytical skills, with hands-on experience building models and interpreting sales metrics

Next steps can vary by role, but usual next steps are a skill or experience interview (e.g. a coding interview for an engineer, a portfolio review for a designer, deeper experience call for other roles) which leads to a virtual or in person interview panel. Priority Commerce is a leading financial technology company on a mission to deliver a personalized, easy-to-adopt financial toolset that accelerates cash flow and optimizes working capital for businesses. Our vision is to eliminate the barriers to unlocking revenue - empowering businesses to grow faster and operate smarter.

We achieve this through the Priority Commerce Engine, an innovative platform that combines payables, acquiring, and banking and treasury solutions. This unified approach allows businesses to streamline financial operations, reduce unnecessary costs, and uncover new revenue opportunities.

At Priority Commerce, we're driven by results. We expect our people tobe known for results- bringing expertise, momentum, and relentless focus to every challenge, helping our clients and each other thrive.

About the Role:

This role owns a multi-project program within one of the product workstreams - Banking and Treasury, Priority Commerce Engine, Merchant and Partner Solutions, or a Core Platform Shared Services domain such as billing or payment rails. You will coordinate several concurrent projects and their interdependencies across engineering, product, and operations, holding one plan and one version of status for the program.

This is an individual contributor role within the Enterprise PMO's Product Launch Delivery tower. It owns how the work ships, not what ships or how it is architected. The role reports to the tower's Delivery Lead and works to the methodology and reporting standards set by PMO Operations and CoE. Customer implementations sit in a separate tower, and product-facing software delivery sits in Product Launch Delivery.

Responsibilities:

• Owns delivery of a multi-project program within an assigned product workstream, including schedule, scope integrity, and dependency management across its constituent projects.

• Maintains the program plan, milestones, critical path, and RAID log, and keeps them current enough to be used for decisions rather than for reporting.

• Coordinates cross-functional delivery across engineering, product, quality, and operations to a shared date.

• Produces effort and duration estimates for planned work, and flags feasibility before a date is committed.

• Runs the delivery cadence for the program: planning, standing reviews, dependency checkpoints, and escalation.

• Manages release entry and exit criteria for the program's releases, partnering with Release Coordination on deployment readiness.

• Carries regulatory and control requirements as plan items where the program touches SOC 2 or PCI DSS scope.

• Reports program status through the EPMO Intelligence Portal to the standards set by PMO Operations and CoE.

• Mentors project managers and associate project managers working within the program.

• Contributes patterns and lessons learned to the launch playbook through the quarterly pattern loop.

What Success Looks Like:

• The program delivers to its committed dates, and slippage is forecast rather than discovered.

• Dependencies between the program's projects are visible and sequenced, not resolved by escalation.

• Engineering and product partners work from one plan and one version of status.

• Scope changes arrive through a defined route with effort and date impact attached, rather than as verbal commitments.

• Release readiness is evidenced, and post-release defects are the exception.

• Project managers in the program grow measurably against the next level's scope.

Candidate Requirements:

Required

• 6-8 years in project or program management, including ownership of a multi-project program with interdependencies.

• Experience delivering software or platform work across more than one engineering team.

• Working fluency with integration and release mechanics: environments,

About Delinea:
Delinea is the identity security platform that continuously controls what AI agents, humans and machines can do and for how long. It extends privileged access management from the point of access to the moment of action, using just-in-time authorization to reduce standing privilege across on-premises, multi-cloud and short-lived infrastructure, without adding friction for legitimate users. Delinea provides visibility across every identity type, scores the risk each one carries, and preserves the context behind access decisions, making them auditable and defensible. It supports both static and ephemeral access, letting teams apply Zero Standing Privilege where risk demands it without replacing existing infrastructure.

The Delinea Field CTO is a senior, hands-on technical advisor for a region or vertical, reporting to the GTM CTO. This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing scale-up at a crucial phase of growth and help change an industry for the better.

About the role

Motorway is rapidly growing its technology team and business, and we are looking for a Developer Experience Security Engineer to help enable a secure, scalable, and frictionless developer experience across Motorway.. We have recently built and rolled out a new container platform on top of AWS Fargate, and are currently enhancing our observability, reliability, and developer-focused tooling. We will continue to build and evolve secure, standardised platform capabilities that reduce cognitive load and help teams ship faster with confidence.

As a Developer Experience Security Engineer, you will ensure that security is built into how engineers build, deploy, and operate software, making the secure path the easiest path you will ensure that security is built into how engineers build, deploy, and operate software.
